referenceMethod: Independent cap-to-near-support-sole spans from fixed upright ready/load/ram cells0/2/3, own-identity integer median; fire cell1 measured only as corroboration. One shared reference per stationary sheet; no phase-height normalization.
annotationMethod: Independent Astra Max manual native-pixel anatomy/cap/sole/barrel-end interpretation; alpha>=64 ROI extrema recomputed read-only. Anatomical projected rootX remains independent from groundROI X, groundY is exclusive maxY. Source bytes unchanged.

sources.muzzleMethod: Fire cell1 only: independently selected native projected barrel-end rim at [486,197], immediately before the long bayonet blade at the short steel/socket junction. The rear three-quarter view partly hides the aperture; the point is an estimated solid rim anchor, not a claim that the bore interior is visible. It is not the bayonet tip or full weapon bound. Alpha>=64 at the selected point is recomputed; expected native placement uncertainty approximately +/-4px.
